joyagoo-qc-photo-checklist.title: Joyagoo QC Photo Checklist: Size, Defects and Missing Views
joyagoo-qc-photo-checklist.description: Check your Joyagoo QC photos in order: exact option, size label, measurements, visible defects and missing views. Use a practical checklist before approving the item.
joyagoo-qc-photo-checklist.summary: Start with the exact order, then inspect the received item. Mark each check as matched, unclear or mismatched. An unclear measurement or missing view needs evidence before you make the next decision.
joyagoo-qc-photo-checklist.caption: A quick QC review sheet
rows: Order: model, colour, version and quantity
Request the relevant label or whole-item view
Size tag plus the seller's stated size system
Keep EU, UK, US and CN labels separate
A labelled measurement using the same points as your reference item
Ask for the missing measurement and unit
Front, back, sides, joins, fastenings and included parts
Identify the exact photo and concern
Current order controls, eligibility and applicable deadline
Clarify promptly before packing or tag removal

joyagoo-fees-explained.summary: Separate what you have paid from what remains estimated. Keep each charge tied to its buying stage, currency and live source so a product price cannot be mistaken for the whole delivered cost.
joyagoo-fees-explained.caption: A cost record without guessed rates
rows: Selected option price and domestic delivery
The exact variation and current payable amount
Its current price and what it includes
Route, packaging, billing weight and freight estimate
Payment conversion or destination charges where relevant
Current provider or authoritative rules; never assume zero

joyagoo-shipping-to-usa-guide.title: Joyagoo Shipping to the USA: Parcel and Route Checklist
joyagoo-shipping-to-usa-guide.description: Prepare a Joyagoo parcel for the USA with destination, product eligibility, packed measurements and tracking checks. Compare live options without fixed-price promises.
joyagoo-shipping-to-usa-guide.summary: Begin with the exact US destination and the products in your parcel. Availability, restrictions and the final charge come from the current route and account details; another buyer's price or arrival date is not a quote for your shipment.
joyagoo-shipping-to-usa-guide.caption: Before submitting a USA parcel
rows: Country, state and ZIP fields match the actual delivery address
Every product characteristic is described accurately
Protection, outer dimensions and actual weight
Billing basis, tracking and current terms
The selected route and dated estimate
Correct parcel and carrier tracking references
The original latest event and any action request

joyagoo-actual-vs-volumetric-weight.summary: Use the outer packed dimensions, keep the units visible and read the selected route's billing rule. The calculation below explains the arithmetic; it is not a freight quote or a claim that all routes use the same divisor.
joyagoo-actual-vs-volumetric-weight.caption: Illustrative calculation with a hypothetical divisor of 6,000
rows: The finished parcel, not one product
Length multiplied by width and height
Only if the selected rule uses this divisor
Only for a greater-of-two rule, before its rounding

joyagoo-tracking-not-updating.summary: Use the parcel record to identify the right number, preserve the last event exactly, and read the selected route's notice. A silent tracking page and an explicit action request need different responses.
joyagoo-tracking-not-updating.caption: Tracking record: what to check next
rows: Parcel tracking number and the matching carrier
Correct the reference or ask which carrier applies
Ask about physical handover if the evidence is insufficient

Respond through the verified channel promptly

joyagoo-shipping-estimate-input-checklis.summary: Record the destination, units, packed measurements and assumptions before comparing results. Update the record whenever the contents or packing change; a provisional estimate cannot establish the final amount.
joyagoo-shipping-estimate-input-checklis.caption: Inputs to keep beside a shipping estimate
rows: Exact selected country and any required region
Outer packed length, width and height with units
Item dimensions used for the parcel
Omitting a characteristic to show more routes
Route, date, currency and included services

joyagoo-links-not-working.summary: Locate the failure before replacing the link: source page, import, selected option or changed product. Preserve the original URL and exact option so a successful page load cannot hide a different item.
joyagoo-links-not-working.caption: Product-link troubleshooting decisions
